title: gluco night sentry support?
body:
hey guys!

any chance to support GlucoSentry? its only just came out but id love to be able to connect it to xdrip...

thanks for all your work :)

comments.body: Get me one to borrow and I expect it is doable.

> Same request here. I think it worths the try: rechargeable battery and no need to stick to the skin
> https://shop.gluconightwatch.com/es/2-inicio
> @jamorham: The team of GlucoSentry told me you already had one for test purposes. How is this? How can I help?
> thanks

i also heard from GS that they supplied one for adding it to xDrip but havnt heard more and its been awhile.

@yosepito  if youre looking for rechargable the MiaoMiao is already supported, waterproof and rechargeable. just be careful with the cable.

@Mr-Enigma Can you provide a link to the product?
Is it still in production?
What are the benefits compared to the devices xDrip currently supports?
Thanks
